d: The animals of Woodsley's Farm help Oliver and his little sister June stage the classic tale of A Christmas Carol to shock their Dad into embracing the spirit of the holidays.

When her kingdom is struck by a terrible curse, a brave young girl embarks on a daring journey to find the Christmas Star and rescue a missing princess. But not everyone is on her side. While traveling through treacherous mountains, aided by mystical forest elves and a spirited brown bear, she encounters a wicked witch and a cunning count determined to thwart her efforts.

t: Maya the Bee: The Honey Games
d: Maya is a determined little bee, but sometimes her determination can get her into sticky situations. When Maya accidentally embarrasses the Empress of Buzztropolis, she is forced to venture beyond her colony and team up with a group of mis-fit bugs in a bid to win The Honey Games and save her life.

NYC ad exec Holly Maddux dreams of the perfect life, the perfect job, and of course, the perfect man to sweep her off her feet. When she wakes up one day to find the perfect man awaiting her, who is nothing more than a mannequin come to life, she must decide if perfect is the perfect fit for her.
When a loss of togetherness spreads across the globe and threatens the existence of Santa's Northpole, a little boy named Kevin is called upon to save the day.
